title: Coherent precipitation of cuboidal nanoparticles in Al1Ti5Zr4Nb3Ta3 lightweight refractory high entropy alloy based on laser metal deposition
process_description: prepared by laser metal deposition using spherical pre-alloyed powder prepared by plasma rotating electrode process (PREP) with laser power 1400 W and scanning speed 500 mm/s under argon atmosphere (oxygen content <1000 ppm).
